verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own GraphQL API lets you list all transcripts and fetch each one's details as structured data (JSON), and Super Admin can query all of a team's data, so data can be retrieved programmatically. Nothing in the evidence shows a dedicated bulk export or download feature, export in named open file formats, or a documented off-boarding path. Missing for 10: one-click or bulk full-account export, documented open export formats (e.g. text/SRT/JSON files, audio/video downloads), coverage of all data types (recordings, summaries, soundbites), account deletion/exit guidance, independent corroboration.
